theme_and_archetype.vibe: Industrial, heavy-duty, modern blue-collar, premium service, cinematic logistics. Anti-generic, anti-SaaS.

headings.usage: Use for all H1, H2, H3. Never use Inter or Roboto.

body.usage: Use for paragraphs, descriptions, and data tables.

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Bento-style grids for features and services. Strict grid for admin dashboard.
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: rounded-none or rounded-sm (max 4px). Heavy industry does not use soft rounded corners.
layout_and_spacing.textures: Use subtle noise/grain overlays over the deep navy backgrounds. Angled/diagonal cuts for section dividers.

hero.layout: Cinematic full-screen with dark vignette. Background image: hero_vacuum_truck.
hero.content: Headline: 'PROFESSIONAL SEPTIC & GREASE PUMPING SERVICES'. Use Teko, text-6xl md:text-8xl, text-white. Include 24/7 Emergency Badge in red.
hero.ctas: Primary CTA: Call Now (amber bg, black text). Secondary: Request Quote (transparent bg, steel border, white text).

trust_badges.layout: Horizontal banner below hero, surface_navy background.
trust_badges.content: Icons: Shield, Hard Hat, Gear, Certified. Text: 'Licensed & Insured', '1800-Gallon Capacity', 'Serving Eastern WA & North ID'.

services_grid.style: Cards use surface_steel. Hover effect: subtle lift, 2px bottom border in amber. Industrial icons (lucide-react).

service_area.layout: Two-column. Left: Map visual/abstract graphic. Right: Text content.
service_area.content: Title: '2-HOUR RAPID RESPONSE RADIUS'. List: Spokane, Coeur d'Alene, Post Falls, Pullman. Background: subtle topographic lines or grid.

emergency_section.layout: Full width, heavy contrast. Dark red to black gradient background.
emergency_section.content: High urgency. 'SEPTIC EMERGENCY? WE DISPATCH IMMEDIATELY.' Big red CTA button.

floating_elements.mobile: Sticky bottom bar on mobile with 'Call Now' and 'Book Online' buttons.
floating_elements.desktop: Floating buttons in bottom right corner.

booking_app.layout: Focused, clean form flow centered on screen.
booking_app.step_1: Service Selection: 4 large selectable chips/cards for service type.
booking_app.step_2: Calendar: Use Shadcn Calendar, customized to be dark mode with amber selected states. Show available time slots below calendar.
booking_app.step_3: User Info Form: Shadcn Forms (Input, Textarea) with square corners, heavy borders.
booking_app.quote_request: Separate tab/route. Simple form for non-urgent bulk jobs.

tabs.calendar_view: Daily/Weekly grid showing confirmed bookings. Color coded: Res (Blue), Com (Steel), Grease (Amber), Emergency (Red).
tabs.quote_requests: Data table (Shadcn Table) listing pending requests. Row hover in surface_steel.
tabs.availability_settings: Form to configure working days, hours, and slot duration.

component_instructions.buttons: Square edges (rounded-none). Font: Teko text-xl or 2xl. Heavy padding (px-8 py-4).
component_instructions.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
component_instructions.file_type: Generate .js and .jsx files, NOT .tsx. Use standard PropTypes or pure JS.
component_instructions.shadcn_overrides: Override Shadcn border-radius to 0. Override ring colors to amber-500. Do not use generic Vercel aesthetic.
